name: channel-github
usage: /channel-github <setup|rank|pending|retag> [words]; a job's stages run by ticket

select.prompt: What does this watch pull? Comma-separated: stars:<login>, org:<org>, user:<login>, repo:<owner>/<name>, search:<github search query> (required on a harvest job; a routines job leaves it blank)

max_captures.prompt: Most repos captured per run (the rest wait for the next run)

jump_abs.prompt: Stars gained since the last capture that re-capture a held repo

jump_pct.prompt: ...or this percent gain (and at least 50 stars)

refresh_days.prompt: Re-capture a pushed repo whose capture is older than this many days

watch.note: Two kinds of job. A harvest job per set of selectors (stars:<login>, org:<org>, ...): every one shares ONE dest, sources/github, so a repo is one page however many watches or clips name it; its target is a bare name (github-stars). One routines job regenerates the list pages: `jobs add github-lists routines=channel-github dest=research/github/github-lists`. Keyless harvest runs at 60 API calls an hour; a token raises it (references/enable.md).
